name: Hearts under Vines
source:
Sage Fermier thought her biggest problem that morning was making it to the Academy in time for her herbal magic exam, but little did she know that she would end up kidnapped in a vampire's castle instead! 

Turns out the vampire, Nicolas de Noctille, thought Sage was the descendant of his past arch enemy, a sun priest. When Nicolas ordered his servant to bring the descendant to him, he never thought he'd find a beautiful woman tied up on his sacrificial altar. On top of that, her blood tastes irresistibly delicious... 

Can Sage convince the vampire to let her go? Who is the mysterious druid who lingers in the greenhouse? Will the zealous vampire hunter save her from the vampire? And what are the ominous dark vines that have engulfed the castle?

It is up to you to find out, if you have the courage. 

[From [url=https://dream-squircle.itch.io/hearts-under-vines]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
那天清晨，赛奇·费米尔原以为自己最大的麻烦不过是赶在草药魔法考试迟到前抵达学院，殊不知自己竟会稀里糊涂地被绑架进一座吸血鬼的古堡！

原来，古堡主人——吸血鬼尼古拉斯·德·诺克蒂尔误把赛奇当成了自己昔日宿敌“太阳祭司”的后裔。当尼古拉斯命令仆从将那名后裔抓来时，万万没想到被绑在祭坛上的竟是一位绝色佳人。更要命的是，她的鲜血尝起来简直美味得令人无法抗拒……

赛奇能否说服这名吸血鬼放自己离开？徘徊在温室里的神秘德鲁伊究竟是谁？狂热的吸血鬼猎人会从魔爪下救出她吗？而吞噬整座城堡的不祥暗黑藤蔓，又隐藏着怎样的秘密？

若你有足够的勇气，一切谜底皆待你亲自揭晓。

[摘自[url=https://dream-squircle.itch.io/hearts-under-vines]itch.io[/url]]
